facts.text: Snow left Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and Swamp Creek (3,930 ft) 5 to 8 days later this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: left June 14; earlier seasons: June 3 (2023), June 16 (2024), June 6 (2025)

evidence.name: Swamp Creek
evidence.detail: left April 19; earlier seasons: May 6 (2023), April 13 (2024), April 14 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Harts Pass (6,490 ft) and the second highest at Swamp Creek (3,930 ft).

evidence.name: Harts Pass
evidence.detail: 59.7 in on April 5; earlier seasons: 53.6 in (2023), 36.2 in (2024), 37.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Swamp Creek
evidence.detail: 10.4 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 18.4 in (2023), 4.2 in (2024), 6.4 in (2025)
